title: EzBucket
description: EzBuckets make buckets extract more water like a sponge and to trigger, it needs a redstone torch
body:
EzBucket is a plugin that enables the bucket to extract more by using a redstone torch. All you do is simply place down redstone torch and stay within 5 blocks, or put in offhand.

Commands:
/ezbucket reload

There is also a config if you want to tweak few things.


 Here is a example of me using the plugin to drain water:
